facts.text: Kevin ordered one for his dog, Mike Hat.
facts.why: Kevin's dog Mike Hat lives with Kevin's mum. Nobody orders tea for him in the film.
facts.fix: Kevin would share, but Mike Hat lives with his mum.

facts.text: Delivered by Benny, from the takeaway downstairs.
facts.why: The delivery man from the restaurant downstairs is a running gag, but the page I opened does not name him Benny.
facts.fix: Delivered late by the takeaway downstairs, as always.
